goal: 開始持續 8 小時自主實驗：先確認 4S2D random_2d 在凍結短視窗幾何模型下是否曾存在可行動作，再依事前分支決定是否從 c50 建立 bounded pilot

conditional_authorization.opportunity_observed: 可從 c50 建立只增加 random_2d 曝光、且一次只提高一個難度軸的 bounded 25-iteration pilot；固定驗收後才可續下一個 bounded pilot
conditional_authorization.mostly_no_candidate_under_frozen_model: 不可提高 4S2D 曝光；改做低密度 random_2d 可行性邊界或課程拆軸診斷
conditional_authorization.indeterminate: 補充診斷，不得直接訓練

invariants: c50 is the only allowed training restart anchor; rejected it25/it50 checkpoints are diagnostic-only
action, observation, reward, network, LiDAR noise semantics, actuator delay and speed_rate remain unchanged
no result or prior evidence may be overwritten or deleted
every rollout or training segment must freeze checkpoint and source fingerprints before launch
NaN, OOM, traceback, source drift, ledger mismatch or missing output stops the active branch fail-closed
interpretation_limit: D5 enumerates constant-action candidates under a frozen 2.4 s geometry model over event-aligned 5 s traces. It does not prove episode-level solvability or physical inevitability.
